scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。 本轮提示：全部论文来自 arXiv，来源多样性未满足；工业实践为 EvenUp，缺少新增大厂案例。

papers.title: The Magnitude Mirage: Rethinking Confidence for Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval
papers.authors: Jamie Holdcroft, Abdelrahman Abdallah, Adam Jatowt
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.15578v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Many production RAG systems implement retrieval abstention by thresholding raw similarity scores, implicitly treating score magnitude as a confidence signal. We demonstrate that this practice degrades systematically as queries require reasoning beyond semantic matching. Across 11 retrieval architectures and 28 datasets, neural retrievers consistently assign high similarity scores to semantically related but constraint-violating documents, causing magnitude-based thresholds to collapse toward near-random abstention performance on logical and temporal reasoning tasks---a failure we term the Magnitude Mirage. To address this without computationally expensive alternatives, we conduct a large-scale empirical study of six zero-cost Query Performance Prediction (QPP) metrics across three cognitive tiers: semantic matching (BEIR), logical reasoning (BRIGHT), and temporal reasoning (TEMPO). Our central finding is that the key improvement comes fr
papers.summary: 论文研究推理型查询中最高相似度不能可靠代表召回成功的问题，用分数间隔和分布指标替换绝对分数阈值。在 BRIGHT 的选择性回答评测中，10% 覆盖率下 Gap@25 的准确率为 74.1%，最高分阈值为 65.8%；摘要报告拒答 AUROC 最多提高 0.16。
papers.key_insight: 对于包含时间、否定或关系约束的社区查询，可从现有 top-k 得分计算最高分与第 25 名之差，作为低成本质量特征。该信号无需追加模型推理，但阈值仍需按业务校准，不能单独保证约束满足；原文主文与附录的检索器数量口径有差异，复现时应核对汇总范围。

papers.title: Mixture-of-Experts Language Models Can Be Strong and Efficient Retrievers
papers.authors: Anubhav Shrestha, Safal Shrestha, Minwu Kim, Torsten Suel, Keith Ross
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.13486v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Recent work has shown that fine-tuning decoder-only large language models (LLMs) for retrieval yields strong first-stage retrievers, with effectiveness improving as backbones grow in size. However, every query and document must pass through the full model, so encoding cost increases with model size. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs activate only a subset of parameters per token and are widely used to scale generative models, yet remain underexplored as retrievers. We systematically study MoE backbones for retrieval by training MoE and dense LLMs from several families using the same procedure, evaluating them across diverse datasets, and measuring query encoding time under the same serving configuration. We show that MoE retrievers outperform dense retrievers with comparable active parameter counts by up to 3.0 nDCG@10 points on BEIR. One of our strongest MoE retrievers matches an 8B dense retriever with 59% fewer active parameters and 18% l
papers.summary: 论文统一训练流程比较稠密与混合专家检索器，研究增加模型容量能否避免同步增加查询编码开销。在相近激活参数下，MoE 在 BEIR 上最多提升 3.0 个 nDCG@10 点；Qwen3-MoE 匹配 8B 稠密模型效果时，激活参数减少 59%，查询编码时间降低 18%。
papers.key_insight: 社区短文本召回可把模型容量和在线激活量分开选型，先固定训练数据、负样本与服务配置再比较效率。原文还验证只减少查询端专家、不重建文档索引的方案，保留超过 99% 检索效果并最多缩短 26% 编码时间；这不等于总显存需求同比下降。

papers.title: Top-K Is Not a Budget for Hybrid Retrieval
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.15143v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Modern hybrid retrieval for RAG typically fuses the Top-$L$ results from dense and sparse retrievers, but a fixed truncation depth may not transfer across changing queries and corpora. Exact fusion removes the dependence on a fixed depth, yet completing a specified Top-$K$ still incurs variable access costs. We present DiBud, which takes an access budget directly as input and incrementally certifies and returns an exact prefix of the RRF ranking over the full lists. Selective access increases certified output within the budget, while budgeted stopping bounds accesses per request. Experiments on five query sets reveal long-tailed costs for completing exact Top-20. At a budget of 2048 accesses, DiBud increases mean certified output within the first 100 positions by 7.86% over balanced access. After budget calibration for 95% quality retention, held-out queries retain 95.05%--97.68% of mean nDCG@20 while using 65.92%--99.53% fewer accesses
papers.summary: DiBud 直接用列表访问次数限制混合检索融合开销，逐步认证完整 RRF 排名的精确前缀。在五组查询上，2048 次访问预算下，前 100 位内的平均已认证结果比均衡访问多 7.86%；校准后保留 95.05%—97.68% 的平均 nDCG@20，访问次数减少 65.92%—99.53%。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索的稀疏与稠密融合可把访问预算和返回条数分开控制，让成本约束直接参与停止决策。精确前缀认证避免把未读到的另一通道得分误当零，但文中节省的是排名列表访问，不是端到端时延；落地前需评估分页接口、随机访问代价及返回不足的兜底。

papers.title: EviQE: Evidence Selection for LLM-Based Query Expansion
papers.authors: Hai Son Le, Amin Bigdeli, Shirin Seyedsalehi, Morteza Zihayat, Ebrahim Bagheri
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.14875v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM-based query expansion increasingly conditions reformulation on documents retrieved from the target corpus, yet most work focuses on how to generate expansions rather than which documents the model should read. We propose EviQE, which aggregates documents retrieved by multiple reformulators, selects a compact evidence set, and uses it for one grounded expansion step. This separates evidence selection from generation and treats reformulators as complementary retrieval perspectives. Across three TREC DL and five BEIR benchmarks, reformulators frequently retrieve distinct relevant documents, so pooled candidates provide higher relevant-document coverage than any individual source. The strongest gains come from relevance-based evidence selection: LLM-Score consistently outperforms direct reformulation, cold-start expansion, and single-source seeded expansion. Additional retrieval-generation rounds provide little benefit once strong condit
papers.summary: EviQE 把查询扩展拆成多路候选汇聚、证据筛选和单轮生成，重点优化大模型读哪些文档。三组 TREC DL 的平均 nDCG@10 从最佳单源的 0.5571 升至 0.5760，五组 BEIR 从 0.5419 升至 0.5513；继续增加检索生成轮次通常没有额外收益。
papers.key_insight: 社区口语化查询扩展可以先合并多种改写召回的帖子，再筛选少量相关证据生成一次扩展，减少多轮调用。原文固定 BM25 与生成器后比较证据选择，因此收益更能归因于输入证据；上线时仍应把文档判分成本、主题漂移和敏感内容干扰纳入对照实验。

papers.title: Route Me If You Can: A Benchmark for Query Reformulation Selection
papers.authors: Hai Son Le, Negar Arabzadeh, Amin Bigdeli, Radin Hamidi Rad, Sajad Ebrahimi, Charles L. A. Clarke, Ebrahim Bagheri
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.14885v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM-based query reformulation can improve retrieval, but no single reformulation strategy is consistently optimal across queries, domains, retrievers, or model backbones. This creates an inference-time decision problem: ``Given an original query and a pool of candidate reformulations, which one should be issued to the retriever?''. Existing studies are hard to compare because they use different reformulator pools, retrievers, relevance signals, training labels, and evaluation metrics. We introduce QueryRoute, a benchmark that freezes the expensive artifacts needed to study this decision reproducibly: original queries, generated variants, ranked lists under multiple retrievers, retrieval scores, and per-query oracle labels. The benchmark contains 3,757 queries, 11 candidate systems, five reformulator backbones, and three retrievers across TREC DL, BEIR, and BRIGHT, yielding 619,905 retrieval outcomes. We benchmark supervised classificatio
papers.summary: QueryRoute 固定查询改写及检索产物，提供 3,757 条查询、11 个候选系统、5 个改写模型和 3 个检索器，共 619,905 个结果。在 BM25 的 TREC DL 测试中，LLM 判别选择器 nDCG@10 为 0.588，高于最佳固定改写的 0.559，但仍低于预知最优选择的 0.666。
papers.key_insight: 对社区搜索，改写策略应按查询选择，并保留原查询作为候选，避免改写损害原有意图。论文发现 BM25 上的选择器收益不能稳定迁移到 BGE 和 SPLADE，因此切换召回器后需要重新评测路由；除平均 nDCG，还应记录每条查询受益、受损及决策成本。

papers.title: Beyond Benchmark Scores: How Synthetic and Authentic Query Distributions Diverge in RAG Evaluation
papers.authors: Filip J. Kucia, Barbara M. Gawlik
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.14579v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: RAG systems are routinely evaluated using synthetic question sets generated from the target document corpus. While this practice provides a useful check on overall retrieval capability, relying exclusively on synthetic benchmarks can mislead under distribution shift and overstate deployment readiness. Synthetic generation spreads questions evenly across the corpus, formulating long, detailed queries; real users put most of their traffic on a few administrative and procedural topics in short queries, while also asking about matters the generator never covers at all. We demonstrate this gap on a university faculty information system, comparing 1,851 synthetic questions generated via Gemini Notebook against 322 authentic queries collected via a student survey. The synthetic and authentic query sets differ significantly: authentic queries average 6.8 words versus 15.7 for the synthetic ones, and draw from only 53 unique sources compared to 1
papers.summary: 研究对比大学信息系统的 1,851 条合成问题与 322 条真实查询，发现真实查询平均仅 6.8 词，合成问题为 15.7 词。在有标注的真实子集上，Qdrant 混合检索 Hit@5 从合成集的 0.896 降至 0.527；其单查询延迟为 2.70 秒，高于最快配置的 0.33 秒。
papers.key_insight: UGC 搜索的评测应保留真实短查询、含糊表达和高频意图的流量分布，不能只用从文档生成的完整问题做模型选择。可将合成集用于覆盖测试，真实日志用于上线决策，同时分组报告 nDCG、召回率和延迟；该论文是单一校园语料实验，不能据此否定所有混合检索。

papers.title: Pre-retrieval Query Clustering for Adaptive Top-k Document Retrieval in RAG Systems
papers.authors: Ye Xia, Emre Yamangil, Haixun Wang
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.13489v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: RAG systems commonly retrieve a fixed number of documents (top-k) to ground generation, but this static approach is brittle: simple queries suffer over-retrieval (adding noise and cost) while complex queries are under-retrieved, causing recall failures that cascade into incorrect answers. Motivated by the question of how many documents must be retrieved to answer an arbitrary query reliably, we propose a practical, general framework for query-adaptive retrieval depth. Offline, we estimate per-query retrieval difficulty by measuring NDCG under the default retriever and deriving a query-specific "saturation" point k* from the NDCG-k curve. Because computing these signals online is expensive, we cluster a large set of queries in embedding space and summarize each cluster with a recommended retrieval depth that targets high coverage (e.g., \textasciitilde{}95\%) using a mean-plus-variance rule. At runtime, the system assigns an incoming quer
papers.summary: 论文针对固定召回数量无法兼顾简单与复杂查询的问题，离线从 nDCG 随召回深度变化的曲线估计饱和点，再按查询向量聚类配置各簇的召回深度。EvenUp 场景的全流量查询测试报告 F1 提升超过 36%，低复杂度簇的 token 消耗减少 14% 且准确率不降。
papers.key_insight: 对社区搜索可先按查询意图和难度分簇，把召回预算从统一 top-k 改成簇级配置，减少简单短查询的无效候选。簇内均值加方差的规则依赖可靠相关性标注与稳定分布，需监测新查询和聚类漂移；原文的问答 F1 收益不能直接当作社区 CTR 收益。

papers.title: IROH: Insightful Ranking Of Humor using Multi-Stage Hybrid Retrieval with Rationale-Distilled LLM Judges for JOKER 2026 Track Task 1 English
papers.authors: Ana-Maria Luisa Mocanu, Sebastian Mocanu, Ciprian-Octavian Truic\u{a}, Elena-Simona Apostol
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.15618v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Our team, VANGUARD, presents IROH (Insightful Ranking of Humor), a three-stage retrieval system for JOKER Task 1 English at CLEF 2026, achieving first place on the leaderboard with 0.6347 MAP. Our pipeline combines hybrid sparse-dense retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and a LoRA-adapted Large Language Model judge ensemble. We employ Gemma 4 to generate query-aware rationales under two prompt strategies, generic and typed, and produce up to four types of structured hard negatives for training data construction. Through an ablation across three cross-encoder architectures, four dense embedders, and eight judge configurations, our key findings are threefold: (1) the rationale-distilled judge is the primary driver of ranking quality, whereas appending rationales to the first-stage index contributes negligibly; (2) structured hard negatives degrade generalisation in nearly all configurations despite inflating local validation scores; and (3
papers.summary: IROH 用稀疏稠密混合召回、交叉编码器和理由蒸馏的大模型判别器处理幽默文本检索，在 JOKER 2026 英文任务取得 0.6347 MAP。单个通用理由版 Qwen2.5-7B 判别器达到 0.6055；GTE 重排器加入构造负样本后，MAP 反而从 0.2843 降至 0.2597。
papers.key_insight: 幽默、反讽等社区短文本需要上下文判别，可借鉴把教师理由蒸馏进小判别器的方式强化末级重排。该研究提醒结构化难负样本可能只改善本地验证，真正评测却退化；多判别器处理上千候选的成本较高，社区线上宜先缩小候选集，并用独立流量检查泛化。

papers.title: HANCLIP: A Family of Hyperbolic Angular Negation Vision Language Models
papers.authors: Hoang-Bao Le, Aiden Durrant, Thai Son Mai, Binh T. Nguyen, Liting Zhou, Cathal Gurrin
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2606.23843v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong cross-modal alignment but remain brittle to negation, often relying on shallow word associations rather than compositional reasoning. Fine-tuning on negation-specific data can also compromise their general purpose capabilities through catastrophic forgetting. We introduce HANCLIP (Hyperbolic, Angular, and Negation), a geometry-aware framework that improves negation sensitivity while preserving the structure of the pretrained joint embedding space. HANCLIP combines a hyperbolic contrastive objective, which models hierarchical relations and semantic asymmetries, with an angular triplet loss that separates negated descriptions from their affirmative counterparts. Using only 20,000 image-text quadruplets, HANCLIP consistently improves performance across CLIP, LongCLIP, and SmartCLIP backbones on the NegBench benchmark, while maintaining or improving zero-shot classification and image-tex
papers.summary: HANCLIP 用双曲对比目标和角度三元组损失强化图文检索中的否定理解，以 20,000 组图文四元组微调。NegBench 上 SmartCLIP-L/14 的文本到图像 R@1 从 43.75 升至 46.29，六项召回指标之和从 427.49 升至 438.36；这是 6 月论文的 9 月修订版。
papers.key_insight: 社区图文搜索中“有猫但没有狗”一类约束，可以通过成对的肯定和否定样本训练匹配几何，减少关键词相似却违反条件的结果。论文对带正向锚点的混合否定改善更明显，纯否定依然困难，部分通用任务也有小幅退化；中文 UGC 场景需要另行验证，不能直接推断线上收益。

papers.title: Benchmarking Embedding Models for ESG Data
papers.authors: Motaz Saad, Veronica Cret\`i, Ivan Gentile, Kianna Kazemi, Antonella Longo
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.15434v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: The use of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) data is fundamental for modern corporate accountability, sustainability reporting, and financial decision-making. Embedding models have emerged as a powerful approach for transforming unstructured ESG text into numerical representations suitable for downstream natural language processing (NLP) tasks. However, their effectiveness in these ESG-specific tasks has not been systematically studied. In this paper, we construct a benchmark dataset specifically tailored to the ESG domain. We benchmark fourteen models, both open-source and closed-source embedding models, comparing their performance with respect to retrieval, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The results demonstrate performance variations across different models, with Qwen3-based models achieving the highest overall performance. This study provides practical insights into which models are better suited for ESG RAG tasks
papers.summary: 论文构建英意双语 ESG 评测集，对比 14 种开源及商业嵌入模型。英文集上 Qwen3-Embedding-4B 的 nDCG 为 0.9830，0.6B 为 0.9784；意大利语集则由 text-embedding-3-large 以 0.9745 领先，显示同一领域内模型排序也受语言影响。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索选嵌入模型时，应分别评测语言、垂类和查询长度，不能把通用榜单或英文分数直接用于中文短文本决策。此研究的查询与文档包含合成构造，多个指标接近饱和，证据强度有限；更适合作为选型清单，再用真实 UGC 标注验证，并测量成本与延迟。
